verifications.evidence: The journal write still precedes the fsync.

regressions.title: Posting deadlocks on a closed book
regressions.description: Post reads the balance, then writes it back without a lock, so two concurrent posts lose one update.
regressions.evidence: go test -race ./internal/ledger -run TestConcurrentPost fails 7 of 10 runs.
regressions.impact: A posted transaction is silently lost with 50 concurrent users.
regressions.blocking_rationale: A pilot with partner books must not lose transactions.
